annotations.title: Fetch a page as text / טקסט מלא של עמוד

description:
The full text (clean markdown) of one page, by an id from search, a page URL on the site, or its ".md" URL. Every page ends with its official sources and data date. Use it to quote a guide or a data page accurately.
הטקסט המלא של עמוד באתר (מזהה מהחיפוש או כתובת), כולל המקורות ותאריך הנתונים.

id.description: An id from search (e.g. "/kia/picanto", "/madrich/ovdan-gamur") or a URL on the site.

name: fetch

citation_url.description: Page to cite (link it when you use the facts).

data_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the data is correct to.

handoff.description: How the person can ask the operator for a quote (offer only when relevant; never automatic).
